jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Own the frontend architecture for our customer-facing dashboard, working closely with design and backend teams to ship fast, accessible features.
responsibilities: Build and maintain React components used across the product
Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-accurate, accessible UI
Improve performance and test coverage of the frontend codebase
requirements: 4+ years of experience with React and TypeScript
Strong understanding of web accessibility standards
Experience with component testing (Jest, Testing Library)

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: Design and scale the services that power our core platform, with a focus on reliability and developer experience.
responsibilities: Design and implement REST APIs used by internal and external teams
Own uptime and performance of core platform services
Mentor junior engineers on backend best practices
requirements: 5+ years building backend services in Node.js or similar
Experience with relational databases at scale
Comfort working in a remote, async-first team

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Shape the end-to-end experience of our platform, from early concepts to polished, shipped features.
responsibilities: Lead design for key product areas from research through delivery
Maintain and evolve our design system
Partner with PM and engineering throughout the product lifecycle
requirements: Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process

jobs.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs.description: Support the analytics team with data cleaning, dashboards, and ad-hoc reporting for our clients.
responsibilities: Build and maintain dashboards in our BI tool
Clean and validate datasets for client reporting
Assist analysts with ad-hoc data requests
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in a quantitative field

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Help us modernize our infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines ahead of a major platform migration.
responsibilities: Migrate legacy infrastructure to containerized services
Set up monitoring and alerting for production systems
requirements: Familiarity with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, etc.)

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description: Support our marketing team with content scheduling, campaign tracking, and social media coordination.
responsibilities: Schedule and publish content across social channels
Track campaign performance and compile reports
Coordinate with designers and writers on content deadlines
requirements: 1+ years in a marketing or coordination role
Comfort with social media scheduling tools

applications.coverLetter: I've spent the last four years building accessible React interfaces and would love to bring that focus to Northwind Labs.
While I'm primarily an engineer, I've collaborated closely with design teams and am excited about this role's cross-functional nature.
I've built and scaled backend services handling millions of requests a day and would love to bring that experience to your platform team.
Design systems work is where I do my best thinking, and I'd love to help evolve yours as the product grows.
I'm interested in exploring marketing-adjacent work alongside my design background.
